title: Detect BioConductor extra packages and handle correctly
Detect locale
description:
This PR adds the ability to detect and normalize locale information and include it in the manifest. Windows support is a little hairy and uses the `systeminfo.exe` program capture the locale (rather then using native code). This is slow so its cached. (The cache can be invalidated via the `shinyapps.locale.cache` option.

Also locale information can be overridden via the `shinyapps.locale` option.

title: Update Authorization System
description:
This PR updates the authorization functions (`addAuthorizedUser()`, `removeAuthorizedUser()`, etc) to use the new shinyapps authentication system. We plan on disabling the old authentication system before going GA.

If an application already has the legacy scrypt authentication system enabled, then the user is prompted to confirm that the exiting password.txt file will be deleted when adding or removing a user.

Some function signatures changed, and I also deprecated `authorizedUsers()` in favor of `showUsers()` and `showInvited()`

title: Support all forms of tilde expansion
description:
The previous regex did not correctly identify all forms of possible tilde expansion.  http://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/html_node/Tilde-Expansion.html

Particularly the form `~fred/foo` would not have matched.
I added a test case as well as fixed the regex.

title: Handle windows paths with both forward and backward slashes.
description:
The linting code had a bug where it did not correctly detect windows paths with backslashes (as is the norm in windows).  I realize that R allows you to have forward slashes in paths as well, but you should probably detect both.

I added a test line for both cases, and updated the tests as well.

title: add linter for capitalization + filepaths
description:
This adds a simple linter that checks filenames for case sensitivity as used in R code. So, for example, a line like:

``` R
read.csv("college.txt")
```

in a project containing a file `"College.txt"` would get the linter warning:

``` R
The following lines contain paths to files not matching in case sensitivity:
32:     file <- read.csv("college.txt")
```

The algorithm here is really simple, but hopefully 'good enough': for each `.R` or `.Rmd` file, we:
1. Extract everything within quotes (either `"` or `'`),
2. Check to see if there is a file of the same name (in a case-insensitive fashion),
3. If there is a match in a case-insensitive way but not in a case sensitive way, then we warn.

I am a bit concerned about the risk of false positives, so I am going to test this on some more apps before merging.

Note that this is overly simplistic in that it would not catch e.g. `file.path("subdir", "College.txt")`; there are yet more static analysis that could be done but this will likely be sufficient for many users.

title: Added an application log endpoint.
description:
@jmcphers @kevinushey Here's the prototype of what we can use to grab the logs from an application. You'll need to grab and rebuild the lucid vagrant image to test this against, or it should make it to production sometime today or early next week, if you'd prefer to wait.

Currently, this should grab a point-in-time snapshot of an app's logs. It should be feasible to do streaming by hitting the log endpoint we're using suffixed with `?tail=1`, but I can't seem to get that to work without tying up the R session indefinitely. The alternative, of course, would be to poll like we do for task logs every couple of seconds.
Feel free to add commits to this PR if you desire.

Thanks!

title: Check for a valid application layout before deployment when linting
description:
This change blocks deployment when the application directory specified doesn't match one of the following conditions:
1. We have `server.R` and `ui.R` in the base directory,
2. We have `server.R` and `www/index.html` in the base directory,
3. We have an `.Rmd` file within the base directory (not so sure on this one)

Comments appreciated!

emit all error messages about invalid dependencies at once
description:
I find it a bit annoying when the number of dependencies is large, and many of them were installed from local source, because I will have to repeat the cycle of "deploy -> fail -> install -> redeploy -> fail again -> install...". Therefore I prefer `createAppManifest()` telling me all the unqualified packages at once.

Now the error message will be like this:

```
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'shiny'

  The package was installed locally from source. Only packages
  installed from CRAN or GitHub are supported.

* Unable to deploy package dependency 'formatR'

  The package was installed locally from source. Only packages
  installed from CRAN or GitHub are supported.
Execution halted
```

title: Add extended application information to applications()
description:
This adds a few fields to the data frame returned by `applications()`, with the goal of driving the RStudio UI that will be built to provide a front-end to the package. In particular:
- The created/updated dates, to show the time of last deployment. 
- The size and instance information, to show initial values so the user knows if they're scaling up or down and by how much.

If you feel that this clutters the output too much, we could move it to another function that outputs more extensive information while `applications()` continues to return more basic data.
